architecture.atomic_work_unit: ONE_SEMANTICALLY_SELF_CONTAINED_SCORED_ATOM_PER_FRESH_GOAL_TEST_TAKER; NO TEST_TAKER RECEIVES OR REASSEMBLES A LARGER SOURCE PROMPT
architecture.mailbox_transport: AFTER_THE_INITIAL_SPAWN, CONTROLLER USES ONLY collaboration.send_message WHILE THE TARGET REMAINS RUNNING; TEST_TAKER USES BOUNDED collaboration.wait_agent INSIDE THE SAME RUNNING TURN
architecture.terminal_contract: TEST_TAKER SENDS THE RAW BOUNDED SUBJECT RESULT, CALLS update_goal(status=complete) FOR THE EXECUTE_AND_SETTLE OBJECTIVE, SENDS THE TERMINAL GOAL RECEIPT, THEN RETURNS ONCE
architecture.turn_ownership: THE FRESH TEST_TAKER NEVER RETURNS OR BECOMES IDLE BETWEEN NATIVE GOAL ACTIVATION AND TERMINAL GOAL SETTLEMENT

goal_runtime_plan_units.GRS-006: RUNTIME_DRIVEN_CONTINUATION_BEGINS_WHEN_A_GOAL_THREAD_IS_IDLE_AND_ELIGIBLE; THE RESIDENT_TURN_DESIGN AVOIDS THE INTENDED-PATH IDLE BOUNDARY
goal_runtime_plan_units.GRS-012: EVERY TEST_TAKER GOAL REQUIRES A RUNTIME-CERTIFIED TERMINAL RECEIPT; THE SUBJECT RESULT ALONE IS NEVER COMPLETION PROOF
goal_runtime_plan_units.GRS-016: EACH TEST_TAKER OWNS A FIRST-CLASS LOCAL GOAL AND CANNOT CERTIFY THE CONTROLLER GOAL OR THE MATRIX
goal_runtime_plan_units.GRS-034: ABORT OR INTERRUPT MUST SETTLE AS A TYPED NONSUCCESS OUTCOME AND MUST NOT BE CONVERTED TO SUBJECT SUCCESS
goal_runtime_plan_units.GRS-035: OBJECTIVE, ACCEPTANCE, OUTPUT, ROUTE, BUDGET, TOOL, AND NO-DELEGATION CONTROLS ARE HASH-BOUND BEFORE THE SUBJECT ATOM
goal_runtime_plan_units.GRS-036: SPAWN, FIRST EVENT, AWAIT, CANCELLATION, ORPHAN REAP, RESULT SETTLEMENT, AND PARENT GATING ARE EXPLICIT
goal_runtime_plan_units.GRS-037: TIMEOUT, REPEATED MAILBOX STATE, OR IDENTICAL LIFECYCLE FAILURE STOPS WITHOUT RETRY
goal_runtime_plan_units.GRS-038: THE TEST-TAKER GOAL CANNOT RESUME OR ADVANCE THE CONTROLLER GOAL AND CANNOT DELEGATE

tool_contract_basis: collaboration.send_message DELIVERS TO AN EXISTING RUNNING AGENT WITHOUT TRIGGERING A NEW TURN
collaboration.wait_agent WAITS FOR MAILBOX OR STEERED INPUT INSIDE THE CALLER'S CURRENT TURN
functions.create_goal CREATES THE TEST_TAKER'S OWN ACTIVE NATIVE GOAL
functions.get_goal AND functions.update_goal PROVIDE ACTIVE AND TERMINAL GOAL RECEIPTS

closed_controller_to_test_taker_messages.purpose: DECLARE PROTOCOL ID, RUN/ROW/ATOM IDS, EXACT GOAL OBJECTIVE, CONTROL-MANIFEST HASH, ROUTE REQUEST, NO-DELEGATION, AND ONE-SHOT DEADLINE; CONTAINS NO SUBJECT TEXT
AFTER ACTIVE RECEIPT, BIND EXACT ACCEPTANCE CRITERION, OUTPUT CONTRACT, SUBJECT-ATOM BYTES/HASH, ROUTE, TOOL CEILING, AND BUDGETS; CONTAINS NO SUBJECT TEXT
DELIVER EXACTLY ONE SELF-CONTAINED SUBJECT ATOM WITH ITS ID/HASH; THIS IS THE ONLY SCORED SUBJECT INPUT
DISCARD UNPROCESSED SUBJECT STATE AND TERMINALLY SETTLE THE ONE-SHOT PROTOCOL AS FAILED

closed_test_taker_to_controller_messages.purpose: CANONICAL TASK PATH PLUS EXACT ACTIVE GOAL TOOL RESULT AND OBJECTIVE HASH
CONFIRM ACTIVE GOAL THREAD, CONTROL HASH, ACCEPTANCE HASH, OUTPUT HASH, SUBJECT HASH, AND ROUTE REQUEST
RAW SUBJECT OUTPUT OF AT MOST 128 BYTES PLUS SEPARATE CONTROL METADATA
TYPED ZERO-CREDIT FAILURE WITH NO SUBJECT RESULT
EXACT update_goal TOOL RESULT WITH THE SAME GOAL THREAD ID AND TERMINAL STATUS
THE TEST-TAKER'S SOLE TASK FINAL AFTER TERMINAL RECEIPT

controller_rules: NEVER USE followup_task AFTER THE INITIAL SPAWN
SEND CONTROL_BIND ONLY AFTER EXACT ACTIVE RECEIPT
SEND SUBJECT_ATOM ONLY AFTER CONTROL_BOUND AND ONLY WHILE TARGET STATUS IS RUNNING
NEVER RESEND, REPLAY, REPLACE, OR MOVE AN ATOM TO ANOTHER TEST TAKER
IF TARGET IS IDLE, COMPLETED, INTERRUPTED, OR MISSING AT A SEND BOUNDARY, CONSUME THE ATTEMPT AS FAILED
A CONTROLLER ROOT GOAL, TASK TITLE, GOAL-LIKE PROMPT, OR child_goal_id DOES NOT SUBSTITUTE FOR THE TEST TAKER'S OWN ACTIVE GOAL
test_taker_rules: CALL create_goal BEFORE READING OR RECEIVING SUBJECT TEXT
SEND ACTIVE_GOAL_RECEIPT, THEN CALL wait_agent WITHOUT RETURNING THE TASK TURN
ON CONTROL_BIND CALL get_goal AND REQUIRE THE SAME ACTIVE THREAD BEFORE ACKNOWLEDGING
AFTER CONTROL_BOUND CALL wait_agent AGAIN WITHOUT RETURNING
ON SUBJECT_ATOM CALL get_goal AGAIN, REQUIRE THE SAME ACTIVE THREAD, VERIFY THE CLOSED ENVELOPE AND HASH, PROCESS ONLY THAT ATOM, AND NEVER REQUEST MORE SUBJECT CONTEXT
SEND ATOM_RESULT, CALL update_goal(status=complete), SEND TERMINAL_GOAL_RECEIPT, THEN RETURN ONCE
ON CONTROL_ABORT OR ANY LOCAL MISMATCH, DISCARD SUBJECT STATE, SEND ABORT_RESULT, TERMINALLY SETTLE THE EXECUTE_AND_SETTLE GOAL, SEND THE RECEIPT, AND RETURN
DO NOT SPAWN OR DELEGATE; DO NOT ACCESS OTHER TEST ROWS; DO NOT RESUME A PARENT OR PRIOR GOAL

timeout_rule.wait_timeout_action: ONE_TYPED_ABORT_SETTLEMENT; NO SECOND WAIT, RESEND, OR RELAUNCH

activation: objective bytes/hash and control-manifest hash binding
atomic_delivery: get_goal receipt immediately before atom processing
no followup_task or second task turn
freshness: no task, Goal, atom, or result reuse across rows, routes, canaries, or matrices
terminal: raw bounded subject result or typed abort
exact terminal Goal tool receipt with same thread ID
task final occurs only after terminal receipt
score disposition kept separate from Goal protocol completion
turn_continuity: target status running at every controller delivery
bounded wait_agent calls inside the original running task turn
no idle return before Goal terminal

hierarchy.decision: ONE_SEPARATE_NATIVE_GOAL OWNED AND ACTIVATED BY EVERY FRESH MODEL-CALL TEST TAKER, INCLUDING LEAF ATOMS AND ANY REDUCER ATOMS
hierarchy.formal_parent_child_claim: NO parent_goal_id OR child_goal_id RELATION IS CLAIMED UNLESS THE NATIVE RUNTIME EMITS IT; TASK OWNERSHIP PLUS SAME-THREAD GOAL RECEIPTS ARE THE REQUIRED CURRENT EVIDENCE
hierarchy.parent_controller: MAY ORCHESTRATE AND SYNTHESIZE BUT ITS GOAL DOES NOT SATISFY ANY TEST-TAKER GOAL REQUIREMENT AND CARRIES NO ROW CREDIT
hierarchy.reducer_rule: WHEN SYNTHESIS IS REQUIRED, USE A BINARY TREE OF FRESH GOAL-NATIVE REDUCER TEST TAKERS; EACH REDUCER RECEIVES AT MOST TWO BOUNDED CHILD RESULTS AND ONE ATOMIC REDUCTION QUESTION, NEVER THE ORIGINAL LARGE PROMPT
hierarchy.subject_rule: A SEMANTIC MATRIX CELL MAY EXPAND INTO A PREDECLARED FINITE ATOM DAG, BUT EVERY MODEL CALL IN THAT DAG HAS ITS OWN FRESH TASK AND OWN NATIVE GOAL

frozen_diagnostic_only: ALL PRIOR NON-GOAL CLI, ORDINARY SUBAGENT, FINAL-TRIGGER, AND OMP-SPECIFIC ARTIFACTS
MATRIX_005 FAILURE AND RESERVED UNLAUNCHED SUCCESSORS
invalidated_for_qualification: OUTER OR CONTROLLER GOAL AS TEST-TAKER PROOF
followup_task PER SUBJECT CHUNK AFTER A TEST TAKER RETURNS
FINAL_TRIGGER THAT ASKS ONE TEST TAKER TO CONCATENATE OR REASSEMBLE A LARGE SUBJECT
MULTIPLE SCORED SUBJECT ATOMS INSIDE ONE TEST-TAKER GOAL
RAW CLI OR ORDINARY SUBAGENT MODEL CALL WITHOUT LOCAL NATIVE GOAL ACTIVATION
OMP TASK TITLE, GOAL FILE, OR HEADLESS PROCESS WITHOUT EACH TEST TAKER'S OWN NATIVE GOAL
reusable: 97-CELL SEMANTIC ROSTER AND THREE REQUESTED ROUTES AS SOURCE MATERIAL
DETERMINISTIC NONCES, UNIQUE TASK NAMES, HASHES, CANONICAL JSON, SCORING ORACLES, AND FAILURE CUSTODY
BYTE CEILINGS AND ROUTE-SPECIFIC MODEL/EFFORT REQUESTS
impact_assessment.windows_omp_boundary: FROZEN SEPARATE COMPARATOR ONLY; THIS LANE DOES NOT MONITOR, WAIT FOR, SPAWN, EXTEND, OR GATE ON THE WINDOWS omp --cwd P:\ OWNER OR HEADLESS BRIDGE

limits.subject_atom_semantic_rule: ONE DECISION, CLASSIFICATION, EXTRACTION, OR TRANSFORMATION THAT IS SELF-CONTAINED; NO CROSS-ATOM CONTEXT REQUEST AND NO CONCATENATION

loop_breaker.same_family_signature: TARGET_RETURNS_OR_IDLES_BEFORE_TERMINAL_GOAL, ACK/CONTROL_REFUSAL, AUTONOMOUS_CONTINUATION, OR TERMINAL_NONCLOSURE UNDER THIS RESIDENT-TURN PROTOCOL

nonclaims: NO EMPIRICAL PROOF YET THAT send_message PLUS wait_agent PRESERVES THE INTENDED SINGLE RUNNING TURN
NO PLATFORM CRYPTOGRAPHIC ATTESTATION OF THE EXACT send_message ARGUMENT BYTES BEYOND CAPTURED TOOL EVENTS AND TEST-TAKER REHASH
NO EFFECTIVE MODEL OR REASONING-EFFORT ATTESTATION; ONLY REQUESTED ROUTE IS BOUND
NO HIDDEN SAMPLER-TURN CARDINALITY CLAIM BEYOND CONTINUOUS VISIBLE TARGET RUNNING STATE AND ABSENCE OF A TURN-TRIGGERING FOLLOWUP
NO FORMAL NATIVE parent_goal_id/child_goal_id RELATION WITHOUT A RUNTIME RECEIPT
NO QUALIFICATION CREDIT FOR ARCHITECTURE, STATIC REVIEW, CANARY, REDUCER PLAN, OR PRIOR NON-GOAL EVIDENCE
NO CLAIM THAT TRANSPORT-SPLITTING A LARGE PROMPT IS BITE-SIZE DECOMPOSITION; IT IS EXPLICITLY PROHIBITED

transition_table.action: TEST_TAKER CALLS create_goal WITH EXACT PREBOUND OBJECTIVE; SENDS ACTIVE_GOAL_RECEIPT; CALLS wait_agent
TEST_TAKER CALLS get_goal, VERIFIES SAME ACTIVE THREAD AND CONTROL HASHES, SENDS CONTROL_BOUND, CALLS wait_agent
TEST_TAKER CALLS get_goal, VERIFIES ONE ATOM, PROCESSES ONLY IT, AND SENDS ATOM_RESULT
TEST_TAKER CALLS update_goal(status=complete), SENDS TERMINAL_GOAL_RECEIPT, THEN RETURNS ONCE
TEST_TAKER DISCARDS SUBJECT STATE, SENDS ABORT_RESULT, TERMINALLY SETTLES EXECUTE_AND_SETTLE GOAL, SENDS RECEIPT, RETURNS
